stops.detail: The natural park of the Prado de Cabanes- Torreblanca () () () () is a Spanish protected area in the province of Castellón, Valencia, an area of wetlands with high landscape value and with several species of water birds. It has an area of 865 ha from the municipalities of Torreblanca and Cabanes.)
